name: Pan-United Corporation Ltd
summary: Pan-United Corporation Ltd, an investment holding company, engages in the concrete and logistics businesses in Singapore and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Concrete and Cement, and Trading and Others. It supplies cement, aggregates, and ready-mix concrete and slag products, as well as refined petroleum products. The company is also involved in the trading of raw materials and bulk shipping. In addition, it manufactures, trades in, and supplies basic building materials. Further, the company provides sustainable technology solutions and marketing services.
